name: jcodec
license_evidence: JCodec project LICENSE and release Maven POM FreeBSD license
input_api: new MPEGAudioDemuxer(NIOUtils.readableChannel(File)).getAudioTracks().get(0).nextFrame() until null; new Mp3Decoder().getCodecMeta(ByteBuffer) and decodeFrame(ByteBuffer, ByteBuffer) per frame
scope: Every MPEG audio frame of an untagged local stream synchronized by MPEGAudioDemuxer and decoded by the Layer III Mp3Decoder: codec, sample rate, channels, frame count, decoded samples per channel
family_note: Same JCodec package and MPEGAudioDemuxer as the jcodec entry in data/java/mp3_id3v2/parsers.json, so it is the same parser family, not an independent one. That entry read only the first frame of a tagged file; this path also runs jcodec's own pure-Java Layer III decoder (org.jcodec.codecs.mpa) over every frame of untagged streams.

popularity.metric: deps.dev directDependentCount summed over all releases

name: jlayer
license_evidence: Pinned Decoder.java and LayerIIIDecoder.java source headers specify GNU Library General Public License version 2 or later; Maven POM says LGPL
input_api: new Bitstream(FileInputStream(local File)); readFrame() and Decoder.decodeFrame(Header, Bitstream) for every Layer III frame; SampleBuffer.getBufferLength()
scope: Every MPEG Layer III frame from an untagged local stream is parsed by Bitstream/Header and decoded by LayerIIIDecoder; reports sample rate, channels, frame count and decoded samples per channel
family: Original JavaZoom JLayer bitstream and Layer III decoder
family_note: Independent of JCodec. The soundlibs, libGDX and dev.mccue JLayer releases are forks or repackagings of this lineage, not additional independent decoder families.
